messages:
sanjay: Auditor (auditor_jane) just asked for a compact playback bundle demonstrating an RBAC change and the KMS envelope usage during a simulated incident. Need a plan to assemble artifacts.
lee: ok. Do they want production traces or can we provide staging equivalents with mappings?
auditor_jane: Staging is fine as long as you provide a clear mapping doc and evidence that the timeline and principals match. Required: applied RBAC state snapshot, terraform/git diffs, KMS decrypt events with key/version, and any incident ticket linkage.
nada: We can create a sanitized tarball: applied rolebinding YAML (kubectl get -o yaml), controller audit lines for relevant principals, cloudkms decrypt events, terraform plan diff, and a README mapping staging->prod. We'll canonicalize timestamps.
sanjay: Important: don't rotate any production keys in the replay. Use staging keyring that mirrors prod naming. Include key version identifiers in logs so auditor can see which version was used.
lee: Our canonical key resource path is projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/llm-wrap. For the playback we'll use projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/staging/cryptoKeys/llm-wrap-staging. I'll add a manifest file that pairs them and call out any differences in KMS policy.
auditor_jane: Also need proof of principal identity: OIDC subject or verifier email in the logs. If you can surface request IDs that link k8s apiserver requests to cloud logging that helps.
nada: Quick question: for RBAC, is `kubectl get rolebinding -o yaml` sufficient or do you want managedFields and apiserver request metadata? We can capture apiserver audit logs with the exact request and response.
auditor_jane: Capture both. ManagedFields + apiserver audit entries that include the principal and requestURI are preferred. `git diff` of infra changes is acceptable as supplemental.
sanjay: We'll tie the change to vuln triage ticket RIF-4321 and include the Slack bridgecall excerpt (sanitized) where the oncall discussed the change. We'll also include the internal playbook step that kicked off the change.
lee: Commands I'll run and include in README:
```
# snapshot applied state
kubectl get rolebinding app-read-access -n infra -o yaml > evidence/rolebinding-app-read.yaml

# apiserver audit slice around change
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_cluster" AND protoPayload.requestUri:"rolebindings" AND protoPayload.authentication.principalEmail:"ops@redwood.ai"' --start-time="2025-03-12T14:05:00Z" --end-time="2025-03-12T14:12:00Z" > evidence/apiserver-audit.json

# extract KMS decrypts
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.decrypt" OR protoPayload.methodName="cloudkms.cryptoKeys.decrypt"' --limit=200 > evidence/kms-decrypts.json
```
nada: I'll run a script to normalize timestamps to RFC3339Z, redact IPs, and compute a sha256 manifest. The tarball will include README.md, mapping.tsv, sha256.txt, gpg.sig (operator-signed), and all evidence files.
auditor_jane: Non-repudiation: include a GPG-signed checksum file from the operator who ran the playback. Also include the oncall-bot entry or a short signed note. That satisfies audit requirements.
sanjay: oncall-bot will post when we execute the staging playback. We'll include its log line inside the bundle and also paste the presigned S3 link in DM to the auditor.
oncall-bot: Staging playback executed by sanjay at 2025-03-12T14:08:12Z 1e03 evidence bundle generated: s3://redwood-audit-temp/1758888888-rbac-playback.tar.gz (presigned link valid 1h).
lee: I'll also include a small sample cipherblob header in the README showing keyId -> cryptoKeyVersion: e.g., {"keyId":"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/staging/cryptoKeys/llm-wrap-staging/cryptoKeyVersions/4"} (ciphertext removed).
auditor_jane: Good. Please ensure the artifact filenames include the timeframe and the sha256 in the manifest. One more: provide a short mapping paragraph explaining any differences between staging and prod (namespace names, key rotation cadence).
nada: Timeline: I'll have the scrubbed bundle + README + sha256 + gpg.signature uploaded by EOD tomorrow. Sanjay will run the playback and collect oncall-bot confirmation.
sanjay: I'll also attach the sanitized Slack bridgecall transcript (remove PII) and reference RIF-4321 in the README. If any logs contain PII we'll replace with [REDACTED] and document where scrubbing occurred.
auditor_jane: Thanks. DM me the presigned link when ready and I'll validate the package. :thumbsup:
lee: SHA256 manifest preview: d2b2f5c9f1a6e4c3a8b5... (full hash included in tar).
nada: Follow-up checklist posted to SOC2 tracker: [x] mapping doc, [x] applied-state snapshots, [x] kms decrypt logs with versions, [x] signed checksum, [x] bridgecall extract.
auditor_jane: Looks complete. Appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll review once we get the link.
